_note: EVERY price below is an EDITABLE ESTIMATE in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. None of it is fetched from a
vendor; it is only what this file says. Check the current price pages of the models you actually run
and edit these numbers before you trust any dollar figure in the UI.
"estimated": true is set on every row so the UI keeps labelling the totals as estimates.
If your frontier sessions run on a subscription rather than per-token API billing, set claudeBilling
to "plan": the dollar figures are then API-equivalent estimates of what the same work would have
cost, not money actually charged to you.
Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored by the server.
_claudeBillingNote: "plan" = frontier sessions are covered by a subscription (dollars shown are API-equivalent estimates). "api" = you pay per token.
_fableEquivalentModelNote: The frontier model the savings figure compares against: 'what this work would have cost if the frontier model had done it'. Point it at whichever model you would otherwise have used.

gpt-6-astra.basis: Standard API equivalent; excludes Fast, Batch and Flex adjustments

_aliasesNote: Short names accepted anywhere a model is given, and used to fold the model ids that appear in CLI transcripts onto one row above. Add your own.
